skills.description_en: Load and isolate project context while preserving state across CCPM phases and sessions.
skills.what: 为 agent 提供阶段化上下文加载与会话恢复。
skills.chain_group: CCPM 规格驱动开发流水线

skills.name: epic-generation
skills.group: PRD 转 Epic 工程 Handoff
skills.description_zh: 把最终 PRD 转成包含 ADR、架构选择、依赖图和技术方案的 Epic 文档。
skills.description_en: Turns a finalized PRD into an Epic plan with ADRs, architecture choices, dependency mapping, and technical approach.
skills.what: 将 PRD 转化为可执行的技术实施方案和依赖规划。
skills.chain_group: CCPM 工程计划到 GitHub 同步工作流

skills.name: github-sync
skills.subcategory_title: 9.2 项目管理 / Issue 追踪
skills.description_zh: 把 Epic 与任务双向同步到 GitHub Issues，维护标签、关系、进度和状态映射。
skills.description_en: Syncs Epics and tasks bidirectionally with GitHub Issues, including labels, relationships, progress, and status mapping.
skills.what: 将 Epic 和任务映射到 GitHub Issues，并持续同步状态。
skills.chain_group: CCPM 工程计划到 GitHub 同步工作流

repo.author: Kaelio
repo.github_description: ktx is an executable context layer for data and analytics agents 🐙 Allow Claude Code, Codex, or other AI agents to query data accurately and with full context of your company

skills.name: analytics
skills.description_zh: 帮助 Agent 发现 ktx 数据源，并用语义层或 SQL 准确分析查询。
skills.description_en: Helps agents discover ktx-connected data sources and analyze them accurately through the semantic layer or SQL.
skills.what: Defines when to invoke ktx analytics and how to discover, inspect, plan, and query data.
skills.dup_catalog: Corey · 组「基座上下文 / 测量」

skills.name: dbt_ingest
skills.group: dbt 元数据入 ktx 语义层
skills.description_zh: 把 dbt YAML 模型与来源映射为 ktx 语义层覆盖和列说明。
skills.description_en: Maps dbt YAML models and sources into ktx semantic-layer overlays and column notes.
skills.what: Explains how to convert uploaded dbt project metadata into ktx semantic-layer overlays and column notes.

skills.name: historic_sql_patterns
skills.description_zh: 读取 historic-SQL patterns 分片，识别跨表重复分析意图，验证 join 标识符后输出结构化 pattern 证据。
skills.description_en: Reads historic-SQL pattern shards to identify repeated cross-table analytical intents and emit verified pattern evidence.
skills.what: 从 historic-SQL patterns 输入中提取可复用分析意图，并生成记忆代理可投影的证据。
skills.chain_group: historic-SQL 记忆构建工作流

skills.name: historic_sql_table_digest
skills.description_zh: 读取 historic-SQL 表使用分片，生成简洁使用叙事，并输出 table_usage 证据供上下文投影。
skills.description_en: Reads a historic-SQL table-usage shard, summarizes how the table is used, and emits table_usage evidence for context projection.
skills.what: 将单个 historic-SQL 表使用记录压缩为结构化 table_usage 证据。
skills.chain_group: historic-SQL 记忆构建工作流

skills.name: ingest_triage
skills.group: Agent 记忆写入冲突处理
skills.description_zh: 在写入前识别并解决上下文包冲突，维护记忆一致性。
skills.description_en: Resolves bundle-ingest conflicts before writes to keep agent memory consistent.
skills.what: 在上下文包写入前分类并消解重复或矛盾。

skills.name: live_database_ingest
skills.group: 数据库 schema 语义层导入
skills.description_zh: 从数据库结构快照创建语义层来源，并生成 wiki 更新。
skills.description_en: Creates semantic-layer sources and wiki updates from live database schema snapshots.
skills.what: 将表结构、注释和外键导入语义层并校验。

skills.name: looker_ingest
skills.description_zh: 从 Looker 运行时 JSON 提取指标、分段和语义，形成可复用上下文知识。
skills.description_en: Extracts metrics, segments, and semantics from Looker runtime JSON into reusable context knowledge.
skills.what: Ingests Looker runtime artifacts into ktx semantic-layer knowledge.

skills.name: lookml_ingest
skills.description_zh: 把 LookML 视图、模型和 Explore 映射为 ktx 语义层来源与连接图。
skills.description_en: Maps LookML views, models, and explores into ktx semantic-layer sources and join graphs.
skills.what: Translates LookML definitions into ktx semantic-layer primitives.

skills.name: metabase_ingest
skills.description_zh: 将 Metabase 问题、模型和指标转换为 ktx 语义层定义，辅助 agent 理解查询上下文。
skills.description_en: Convert Metabase questions, models, and metrics into ktx semantic layer definitions so agents understand query context.
skills.what: 用于 Metabase bundle 场景，提取卡片、SQL、元数据和引用关系并生成 KSL 定义。

skills.name: metricflow_ingest
skills.description_zh: 将 MetricFlow 语义模型和指标映射为 ktx 语义层来源，统一 agent 查询上下文。
skills.description_en: Map MetricFlow semantic models and metrics into ktx semantic layer sources to unify agent query context.
skills.what: 用于 MetricFlow YAML 场景，解析 semantic_model、measure、entity 和 metric 映射。

skills.name: notion_synthesize
skills.description_zh: 把 Notion 页面与证据合成持久 wiki 记忆和语义层来源。
skills.description_en: Synthesizes Notion pages and evidence into durable wiki memory and semantic-layer sources.
skills.what: 从 Notion 原始内容生成可复用上下文记忆和语义层来源。
skills.chain_group: Notion 上下文入库到语义层查询
skills.chain_group_en: From Notion context ingestion to semantic-layer querying

skills.name: sl
skills.description_zh: 读取并查询公司语义层 YAML，帮助 agent 准确使用业务指标。
skills.description_en: Reads and queries company semantic-layer YAML so agents can use business metrics accurately.
skills.what: 用 sl_query 读取预定义指标、来源、连接和分段。
skills.chain_group: Notion 上下文入库到语义层查询
skills.chain_group_en: From Notion context ingestion to semantic-layer querying

skills.name: sl_capture
skills.group: Agent 记忆 / 工作笔记
skills.description_zh: 帮助记忆代理捕获可复用指标、维度、连接模式，并写入 ktx 语义层。
skills.description_en: Helps the memory agent capture reusable metrics, dimensions, and join patterns into ktx’s semantic layer.
skills.what: 让记忆代理把可复用的指标、维度、连接模式沉淀到语义层。
skills.chain_group: KTX 回合后记忆捕获工作流

skills.name: wiki_capture
skills.group: Agent 记忆 / 工作笔记
skills.description_zh: 帮助记忆代理沉淀业务定义、过滤规则和组织约定到 wiki 知识库。
skills.description_en: Helps the memory agent preserve business definitions, filters, and organizational conventions in a wiki knowledge base.
skills.what: 让记忆代理把组织业务规则和偏好沉淀为 wiki 页面。
skills.chain_group: KTX 回合后记忆捕获工作流

skills.name: ktx
skills.group: ktx 数据 Agent 上下文层配置
skills.group_en: ktx Data Agent Context Layer Setup
skills.description_zh: 帮助 agent 非交互安装和配置 ktx，连接数据源、初始化上下文、嵌入与集成并验证可用性。
skills.description_en: Helps an agent install and configure ktx non-interactively, connect data sources, initialize context and embeddings, wire integrations, and verify readiness.
skills.what: 安装、配置、接入并排错 ktx 数据 Agent 上下文层。
